video.title: Mountain Weather Update 11/6, Meteorologist Chris Tomer

description: Major storm cycle for PNW/BC through 11/15 with heavy high elevation snow accumulation and rain at lower elevations.  This is a moderate/strong intensity atmospheric river.  It's a waiting game for the Intermountain West.  The pattern might break on/after 11/16.
